newsitem.title: USA: Cityscape, unit sues Times of London.
newsitem.headline: Cityscape, unit sues Times of London.

text.p: Cityscape Financial Corp, a consumer finance company, said it and its subsidiary in the United Kingdom have filed libel proceedings against The Times of London for alleged defamatory business articles published on August 16.
Cityscape said David Steene, managing director of the U.K. unit, City Mortgage Corp, is also a plaintiff in the complaint.
It said that those named in the suit are Gavin Lumsden, a journalist, Peter Stothard, editor of the Times, and Times Newspapers Ltd, a unit of News Corp.
In a statement, Cityscape and the other plaintiffs said the Times articles made grossly defamatory, highly damaging, and false allegations about them, all of which they vigorously deny.
It said the plaintiffs would demand an immediate apology, damages and assurances that the defendants would not repeat the allegations.
In London, the Times' legal department confirmed the writ had been issued, but said it had not seen the statement of claim yet.
"As things stand at the moment, we shall certainly defend it," a representative from the department told Reuters.
